question: Which of the following is the effective annual rate of interest corresponding to a compound interest rate of 9% per annum compounded half-yearly?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Half-yearly rate = 9% ÷ 2 = 4.5%

Effective rate = (1 + 4.5/100)² − 1

= (1.045)² − 1 = 1.092025 − 1

**∴ Answer = 9.20%**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Nominal rate = 9% per annum

Compounded half-yearly ⇒ 2 times in a year

**Formula used:**

Effective Rate = (1 + r/2 ÷ 100)² − 1

 
• 0 1 yr +4.5% +4.5% 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Half-yearly rate = 9 ÷ 2 = 4.5%

⇒ Effective Rate = (1 + 4.5/100)² − 1

⇒ = (1.045)² − 1

⇒ = 1.092025 − 1

⇒ = 0.092025 = 9.20%

**∴ The correct answer is 9.20%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Effective Annual Rate

Effective rate = (1 + r/n)ⁿ − 1, where n = number of compounding periods.

Half-Yearly Compounding

Rate is divided by 2 and time is multiplied by 2.

Quarterly Compounding

Rate is divided by 4 and applied 4 times in a year.

SI vs CI Growth

CI gives higher return than SI due to compounding effect.
